تكتنزوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَنِزُوا (taktanizū) /tak.ta.ni.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# تُكْتَنَزُوا (tuktanazū) /tuk.ta.na.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
